title: The Auditor
body: It is holding a form with your name on it. The form is already signed. Its face is a blur of badges. The chair it sits in is yours. Recommended: do not proceed. — M.

choices.label: Step forward. Ask whose signature that is.

outcome.text: It turns the form around. The signature is yours. You have not signed it yet. The lights go.

choices.label: Do not proceed. Take the key. Leave.

outcome.text: The Auditor does not follow. In the envelope: the NULL KEY — a key the map doesn't have. The zone's prize is the discovery, not the dying.
